summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing open-market share repurchases from August 24-28, 2026, under its EUR 1 billion buyback program announced February 17, 2026. The company bought 155,000 ordinary shares on US venues at $107.43-$109.78 average and 59,393 on London venues at GBP 79.42-80.99 average, with Goldman Sachs executing. Repurchased shares will be cancelled. This routine buyback disclosure represents ongoing capital return to shareholders, not a special event. Watch for continued program execution pace and potential tender offer if the company accelerates repurchases.
